scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none
scales.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight
scales.small_caps: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-stone-400

spacing_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. 'Godly' editorial style. Allow images and typography to breathe. Emphasize asymmetry and negative space.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C5A059] text-black hover:bg-[#D4B371] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-medium
buttons.outline: border border-white/20 text-[#E6E2DD] hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-medium

cards.dish_card: group relative overflow-hidden bg-[#141210] border border-white/5 rounded-none
cards.hover_effect: image scales up slightly (scale-105 duration-700), overlay darkens, text translates up

forms.input: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 focus:border-[#C5A059] text-[#E6E2DD] placeholder:text-stone-600 rounded-none px-0 py-4 focus:ring-0 transition-colors shadow-none
forms.rules: Use Shadcn Form/Input logic but strip standard Vercel rounded borders. Make it look like a high-end editorial contact form.

motion.scrolling: Use lenis or simple smooth native CSS scroll. Emphasize slow, elegant transitions.

framer_motion.fade_up: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }} viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}
framer_motion.image_reveal: Wrap images in a container with overflow-hidden, and animate the image from scale 1.1 to 1 on scroll.

hero.description: Serious male chef with beard in uniform, low angle indoor shot.
hero.usage: Hero section background with bg-black/50 overlay to ensure text contrast.

about.usage: About/Bio section side image, styled elegantly.

awards.description: Elegant flat lay of gourmet dishes showcasing culinary presentation.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (links, buttons, inputs, form submissions) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case. E.g., `data-testid='hero-cta-button'`, `data-testid='instagram-link'`, `data-testid='consultation-form-submit'`.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn card or button border-radius. Force `rounded-none` for an editorial, sharp look.
Header must be dark glassmorphism (`bg-[#0A0908]/70 backdrop-blur-xl`) or solid dark. Do NOT leave it fully transparent if it scrolls over text/images.
For the hero image overlay, use `bg-black/50` or a gradient to ensure text readability while letting the image shine.
Include `lucide-react` icons (Instagram, Facebook) in the contact section to replace generic text.
Use Framer Motion to slowly reveal dishes and project images as the user scrolls (fade up and slow scale-down on images inside containers).
Form inputs should look like elegant underline inputs, not standard boxed inputs.
